text:
clare: Heads-up — onboarding quickstart broke after I flipped JSON_MODE on. Our tool declares positional params (ids, opts) as a top-level array but the Node helper is sending a named-object instead and the sample validator rejects it.

miguel: Can you paste a tiny repro and the exact validator output? Which SDK version?

clare: Repro (fast):
1) git clone github.com/redwood/sample-kit && cd positional-quickstart
2) yarn && JSON_MODE=1 node server.js
3) POST /generate to invoke tool 'batch_fetch' which expects arguments: [number[], {hydrate:boolean}]

Observed console: node quickstart prints `function_call.arguments = {"ids":[1,2,3],"opts":{"hydrate":true}}`
Validator error: `expected array at /parameters but got object`

toni: That's weird — the serializer normally respects a top-level array schema and sends a raw array. Did you recently enable the named-params helper that maps handler parameter names into the args object? That helper was intended for convenience for non.jsonMode flows.

clare: I'm on node-sdk 0.14.1. Python quickstart still sends `[ [1,2,3], {"hydrate":true} ]` and passes. Node started sending the named-object after the helper landed in 0.14.x.

alex: Quick mitigation in sample-kit: add a shim that accepts either shape and converts `{ids, opts}` -> `[ids, opts]` before validation. But that's a bandaid for onboarding.

miguel: We need to decide canonical shape: positional arrays or named objects. For tools that model tuples, positional arrays are clearer (and smaller tokens). If we standardize on arrays, SDKs must not convert them to named objects. Can we detect the schema and bypass the named-params helper?

toni: Yes — patch idea: when parameters.schema.type === 'array' (or schema is a tuple-like items list), the serializer should send raw array and skip named mapping. Also add a lint in the CLI that warns when a handler's JS signature suggests named params but tool schema is positional.

infra-bot: Issue created: DEVEX-1422 "node-sdk: named-params helper converts positional tool schemas to objects in jsonMode" (prio: high, assignee: @toni).

sdk-bot: Note: add unit tests for serializer parity vs Python. Also add e2e in sample-kit that tests positional array vs named-object acceptance.

clare: For the short term I pushed the shim to sample-kit so new users won't be blocked by quickstarts. I'll revert after SDK fix. Also opened a minimal failing test that asserts the Node serializer sends an array for tuple schemas.

miguel: Thanks. Let's make the test a gate for the SDK release so this doesn't slip through again. I'll pair with @toni on the patch this afternoon.

clare: Great — marking DEVEX-1422 blocked on SDK unit+e2e + CLI lint.
